target_disease: Congenital neuromuscular disorder with dysmorphic facies
mimic_disease: Spinal Muscular Atrophy with Respiratory Distress Type 1 (SMARD1)
overlapping_phenotypes: Severe infant hypotonia, distal contractures/foot deformities, respiratory compromise
discriminating_phenotype: Neonatal respiratory distress, dysmorphic facies, microcephaly
discriminating_logic: Neonatal respiratory distress is present in nearly all SMARD1 infants but was absent (0/5) at birth in FILIP1 disease; SMARD1 also lacks dysmorphic facies and microcephaly.

target_disease: Congenital neuromuscular disorder with dysmorphic facies
overlapping_phenotypes: Congenital hypotonia, contractures, delayed motor milestones, CNS involvement
discriminating_phenotype: Serum creatine kinase (CK) level, cobblestone lissencephaly, ocular malformations
discriminating_logic: Serum CK levels in FILIP1 disease are normal or only mildly elevated (<3-5x ULN) vs >10-50x ULN in CMDs/dystrophinopathies; FILIP1 lacks severe cobblestone lissencephaly or ocular malformations.

target_disease: Congenital neuromuscular disorder with dysmorphic facies
overlapping_phenotypes: Core-like myofibrillar disintegration on muscle biopsy, facial weakness, axial contractures/scoliosis
discriminating_phenotype: Obligate microcephaly, obliteration of distal palmar and plantar skin folds
discriminating_logic: Microcephaly (5/5) and obliteration of distal palmar and plantar skin folds (5/5, 1/1) are present in FILIP1 disease but virtually never present in isolated congenital core myopathies.
